title: FPT Retail targets robust growth after record profit year

title: Vietnamese firms bet big on 2026 with ambitious profit targets
snippet: FPT Retail (HoSE: FRT) has approved its 2026 business plan, targeting consolidated revenue of VND59.5 trillion ($2.29 billion) and pre-tax profit of VND1.55 trillion ($59.68 million), up 16% and 27%, respectively, from 2025.
